Reading Seminars

Hanzhen Bao

Introduction of the program

This reading seminar is a place to study mathematics carefully, discuss proofs, and keep a record of questions and ideas. The program brings together reading in topology, differentiable manifolds, and Riemann geometry.

Each meeting begins with a selected text. Reading notes are prepared, revisited in discussion, and supplemented with examples and further observations. These pages collect that work as it develops.
